_comment: Declared target platform baseline for release assembly.
This is the COMPATIBILITY WITNESS, not a support promise. Naming this image
does not commit Globular to supporting every unpatched Noble host back to
April 2024; it fixes one reproducible target so 'is this bundled deb
installable' has a determinate answer at build time, with no cluster
Chosen window: systemd 255.4-1ubuntu8.15 entered Noble in April 2026 and
8.16 did not land until 2026-06-08, so release-20260518 sits cleanly inside
the 8.15 window. Pin the image by SHA-256 from the release's signed
SHA256SUMS, and pair it with the archive snapshot below so apt cannot drift
onto today's archive and silently turn the fixture into a different
'provides' lists packages supplied BY THE BASE IMAGE. A bundled deb whose
dependency resolves here is installable offline; one that resolves nowhere
is UNKNOWN, and unknown fails closed.
